article.headline: France storms back with four late goals to dismantle Belgium 4-1
article.summary: France maintained their lead in Nations League Group 1 after scoring four goals in the final 14 minutes to defeat Belgium at the Stade de France.
article.body:
Dodi Lukebakio put Belgium ahead in the 35th minute with a left-footed strike, silencing the home crowd as the visitors held their lead for over an hour. The tactical landscape shifted dramatically when manager Zinedine Zidane introduced Michael Olise, Rayan Cherki, and Lucas Da Cunha in a triple substitution. This late offensive surge shattered the Belgian defensive block, with France netting four times in the final 14 minutes to turn a deficit into a commanding 4-1 victory. Before the late collapse, Belgian goalkeeper Maarten Vandevoordt had anchored his side’s defense, producing a series of acrobatic saves to frustrate French attackers like Bradley Barcola and Esteban Lepaul.

This result keeps France at the summit of Nations League Group 1, building on their previous 1-0 win in Brussels. For France, the match demonstrated depth and tactical flexibility, as the substitutes directly influenced the outcome after the starting lineup struggled to breach the Belgian low block for the majority of the contest. The victory serves to cement France’s position at the top of the group standings.

According to Goal.com, the match featured an experimental French defensive pairing of Maxence Lacroix and Leny Yoro. The Guardian notes that the performance of Vandevoordt continues a long-standing Belgian tradition of producing high-caliber goalkeepers. While the first hour of play was defined by Belgian discipline, the final quarter of the match saw France dismantle the visitors through a rapid-fire sequence of goals from Desire Doue, Rayan Cherki, and Michael Olise.

article.headline: Lakers open revamped roster against Kings with Kessler in focus
article.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers begin their preseason Monday against the Sacramento Kings at Golden 1 Center, with new center Walker Kessler and young wings Cameron Carr and Adou Thiero getting significant playing time.
article.body:
Los Angeles brought in seven new players this offseason to rebuild its roster depth, making Monday's preseason opener against Sacramento a chance to see how the pieces fit together. The Lakers signed Williams and Thybulle for their defensive prowess and three-point shooting, while Sexton will anchor the bench as a scoring option. Kessler, who the team acquired for two unprotected first-round picks and two pick swaps, will play limited minutes but offers the most intrigue as he pairs with stars Dončić and Reaves.

Monday's game matters because preseason provides the first look at how these acquisitions blend on the court. Star players like Dončić and Reaves will see limited minutes, typical for exhibition games, allowing the roster's new wing prospects and younger players to showcase their abilities. Carr and Thiero impressed during the 2026 NBA Summer League, averaging 18 and 15.4 points per game respectively, and both will get significant looks.

The Lakers are banking on their hybrid wings to defend and stretch the floor next to Dončić. The team also acquired Kessler, Looney, Mamukelashvili, Grimes, and Sexton, along with Williams and Thybulle, creating a nearly complete roster overhaul from the offseason. Kessler's rim protection and chemistry with the guards will be watched closely despite his expected limited playing time.

article.headline: Singapore Tightens Safety Rules Following Seven Recent Workplace Fatalities In Construction
article.summary: The Ministry of Manpower mandates a voluntary safety time-out and harsher penalties after seven workers died in September.
article.body:
Seven workers died in workplace incidents throughout September, prompting the Ministry of Manpower to demand immediate action. Among the recent casualties, a 22-year-old worker fell from the 12th storey of a construction site, while two others drowned after their work platform dislodged at Tuas Port. Another fatal accident involved a 35-year-old struck by a pressurized hose at a construction site. These tragedies serve as a grim reminder that safety protocols must not be neglected.

For businesses in the construction, transportation, and storage sectors, these changes directly impact operational freedom and financial liability. Companies are urged to review all health procedures, specifically targeting the use of concrete pumps and vehicle safety mechanisms like wheel chocks and handbrakes. Failure to comply with evolving standards now carries more severe consequences, potentially halting work for months or cutting off access to the migrant-worker labor pool.

According to the Ministry of Manpower, firms are encouraged to conduct a voluntary safety time-out from Oct 5 to Oct 18. Simultaneously, the government is rolling out an enforcement operation running from Oct 5 to Nov 4. First-time composition fines will jump from S$2,000 to S$3,000, and minimum stop-work orders are expanding from five weeks to eight weeks. In the most serious cases, companies may face a three-month ban on hiring new migrant workers.

Minister of State for Manpower Dinesh Vasu Dash stated that the government must act decisively to stop the loss of lives. These measures mirror a previous intervention implemented nationwide between June 26 and July 31 following a similar spate of fatalities earlier in the year.

Ранее, еще летом, были также отменены полеты в Шарм-эль-Шейх из Бреста.

article.headline: السعودية تلغي حفل جوائز Joy Awards لعام 2027 ضمن إعادة تقييم الإنفاق
article.summary: تشير تقارير إلى إلغاء حفل Joy Awards السنوي في الرياض لعام 2027، وذلك في إطار مراجعة شاملة لنفقات قطاعي الترفيه والثقافة.
article.body:
يأتي إلغاء حفل جوائز Joy Awards المقرر إقامته في يناير 2027 ضمن سلسلة من التحولات في الأجندة الترفيهية السعودية، حيث تراجع المملكة حاليًا أولويات الإنفاق في ظل ضغوط مالية. ورغم كون الحفل أحد أبرز المناسبات السنوية التي تجمع نجوم الفن العرب والعالميين في الرياض، إلا أن الهيئة العامة للترفيه ومجموعة MBC، المنظمتين للحدث، لم تصدرا بيانًا رسميًا يؤكد الإلغاء حتى الآن، وذلك وفقًا لما نقلته وكالة رويترز عن مصادر مطلعة.

تكمن أهمية هذا القرار في كونه مؤشرًا على تغير بوصلة التمويل للمشاريع الترفيهية الكبرى في المملكة. ويأتي هذا التوجه في سياق أوسع يشمل إعادة تقييم وتأجيل عدة مشاريع ضمن رؤية 2030، وذلك نتيجة للضغوط المالية وتأثيرات الحرب، مما أدى إلى تقليص أو تأجيل عدد من الفعاليات الدولية والمشاريع الإنشائية الكبرى، مثل تطوير مشروع «ذا لاين» في نيوم، ومجمع المكعب في الرياض، بالإضافة إلى إلغاء مهرجان «ساوند ستورم» الموسيقي.

تاريخيًا، انطلقت هذه الجوائز من منتدى «جوي» عام 2019، وشهدت منذ ذلك الحين مشاركة أسماء عالمية مرموقة مثل شاروخان، وجاكي شان، وأنتوني هوبكنز، ومورغان فريمان. وفي النسخة الأخيرة التي أقيمت في يناير الماضي، كُرّم عدد من النجوم المصريين واللبنانيين بجانب حضور فنانين عالميين مثل كاتي بيري وروبي ويليامز، كما شملت التكريمات جوائز إنجاز العمر لنجوم من بينهم فورست ويتيكر.

من المقرر أن تتزامن هذه التغيرات مع تأجيلات أخرى، حيث أُرجئ مهرجان البحر الأحمر السينمائي الدولي في جدة إلى أواخر عام 2027 بعد مراجعة لوجستية، في حين يُتوقع أن يعود مهرجان «ساوند ستورم» في عام 2027 بعد إلغاء دورة هذا العام. وتشير التقارير إلى أن حالة عدم اليقين الناتجة عن التوترات الإقليمية قد جعلت أيضًا مهمة تأمين حضور النجوم العالميين أكثر صعوبة، مما دفع السلطات السعودية إلى إعادة النظر في توقيتات ونطاق الفعاليات الكبرى القادمة.
